subject.title: Bound plugin bundle command file reads with size cap

question: Should installed Claude bundle command Markdown files above 1 MiB be rejected with a warning and skipped on upgrade?
rationale: The code safely implements either outcome, but the repository has no established documented maximum for this existing user-installed content surface.

options.title: Accept the 1 MiB warn-and-skip contract
options.body: Merge the current approach, treating one MiB as the supported maximum while retaining its actionable diagnostic and sibling continuation.

options.title: Use a different compatibility policy
options.body: Choose a larger cap or a different handling contract if legitimate existing bundle commands must continue loading beyond one MiB.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1 MiB warn-and-skip contract
recommendation.body: Merge the current approach, treating one MiB as the supported maximum while retaining its actionable diagnostic and sibling continuation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor connected to both the prior merged bounded-read pattern and this bundle-command implementation.
